title: Historic Loft | Steps to Broadway!
description:
Stay in the heart of it all! This stylish historic loft is steps from Broadway’s Honky Tonks, 2nd Ave, Bridgestone Arena, and Nissan Stadium—you truly can’t beat the location. With 4 comfy beds, 2 baths, a full kitchen, in-unit laundry, modern furnishings, and parking included, it’s ideal for groups. Good to know: the building dates to the 1800s, so occasional dust or a rare bug may occur. Stairs are required, and you will hear downtown noise, especially at night.

The space
The property is on the corner of Broadway and 2nd Ave. Next to Hard Rock and Chief's. IDEAL LOCATION!

Guest access
24 Hour Automated Check-in/Out

Other things to note
Due to our unbeatable location in the heart of downtown, you’ll experience some ambient noise from nearby bars—perfect for those who want to be right in the action!

Good to know: the building dates to the 1800s, so occasional dust or a rare bug may occur. 

Parking for one car (in a garage one block away) will be validated during your stay.

Please note: You must climb one flight of stairs to reach the apartment. We do not have an elevator on site.

*Local Discounts, Baggage Services, Party & Bachelorette Planning, and Decor Services Available Upon Request*
